title: The solute carrier transporter SLCO5A1 as a novel therapeutic target for the treatment of myocardial infarction-induced heart failure.
authors: Liu, Ke-Yu; Gong, Ke; Fang, Fang; Chen, Qing-Hua; Xu, Jin-Rong; Zhang, Liang-Qing; Chen, Wen-Liang
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦心肌梗死后心衰的SLCO5A1转运蛋白靶点，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟建模方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Heart failure (HF) following myocardial infarction (MI) remains a major threat to health worldwide. While transcriptomics has revealed numerous genes whose expression is altered in HF, distinguishing therapeutic targets remains challenging. In this study, we aimed to identify novel therapeutic targets for HF and explore potential pharmacological interventions. We integrated human HF datasets with weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA) and machine learning (LASSO/SVM-RFE) to screen for candidate genes and applied Mendelian randomization (MR) to assess causality. SLCO5A1 emerged as a prioritized candidate, as it showed a genetically supported protective association with HF and was consistently downregulated in the ischemic failing myocardium. In mice, cardiomyocyte-targeted SLCO5A1 overexpression attenuated post-MI systolic dysfunction and pathological remodeling. Using drug-gene signature mining followed by biophysical and cellular validation, we identified 3-iodothyronamine (T1AM) as a small molecule that directly binds to SLCO5A1 and increases SLCO5A1 protein levels. Pharmacological administration of T1AM increased post-MI survival, improved cardiac function and reduced fibrosis; these benefits were markedly weakened by cardiomyocyte-specific SLCO5A1 knockdown, supporting a functional requirement for SLCO5A1. Mechanistically, SLCO5A1 reduced cardiomyocyte transforming growth factor beta 1 (TGF‑beta1) secretion, thereby limiting fibroblast Smad3 activation and myofibroblast marker expression in conditioned-medium assays. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate that SLCO5A1 is a cardioprotective regulator of cardiomyocyte-fibroblast communication in post-MI HF and support a pharmacological increase in SLCO5A1 levels as a potential therapeutic strategy. SLCO5A1 serves as a novel therapeutic target for heart failure. Enhancing SLCO5A1 expression protects against MI-induced HF by inhibiting TGF-beta1/Smad3-mediated cardiomyocyte-fibroblast crosstalk.
abstract_zh: 心肌梗死（MI）后心力衰竭（HF）仍是全球健康的主要威胁。尽管转录组学已揭示众多在HF中表达改变的基因，但区分治疗靶点仍具挑战性。本研究旨在识别HF的新型治疗靶点，并探索潜在的药物干预措施。我们整合人类HF数据集与加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）及机器学习（LASSO/SVM-RFE）筛选候选基因，并应用孟德尔随机化（MR）评估因果关系。SLCO5A1被确定为首选候选基因，因其显示出与HF的遗传支持的保护性关联，且在缺血性衰竭心肌中持续下调。在小鼠中，心肌细胞靶向的SLCO5A1过表达减轻了MI后收缩功能障碍和病理性重塑。通过药物-基因特征挖掘及生物物理和细胞验证，我们鉴定出3-碘甲状腺胺（T1AM）为一种直接结合SLCO5A1并增加SLCO5A1蛋白水平的小分子。T1AM的药理给药提高了MI后存活率，改善了心脏功能并减少了纤维化；这些益处因心肌细胞特异性SLCO5A1敲低而显著减弱，支持SLCO5A1的功能需求。机制上，SLCO5A1减少了心肌细胞转化生长因子β1（TGF-β1）的分泌，从而在条件培养基实验中限制了成纤维细胞Smad3激活和肌成纤维细胞标志物表达。总之，我们的发现表明SLCO5A1是MI后HF中心肌细胞-成纤维细胞通讯的心脏保护调节因子，并支持药理学增加SLCO5A1水平作为潜在治疗策略。SLCO5A1作为心力衰竭的新型治疗靶点。增强SLCO5A1表达通过抑制TGF-β1/Smad3介导的心肌细胞-成纤维细胞串扰来保护免受MI诱导的HF。
